source_document.citation: Fragala MS, Cadore EL, Dorgo S, Izquierdo M, Kraemer WJ, Peterson MD, Ryan ED. Resistance Training for Older Adults: Position Statement From the National Strength and Conditioning Association. J Strength Cond Res. 2019;33(8):2019-2052.

source.note: Table 1 is captioned for 'healthy older adults'. The source's own study inclusion criteria used subjects aged 50 and older, but this reflects research eligibility, not a stated audit-engine age cutoff. This audit adopts age >=65 as the provisional threshold for routing to the older_adult_healthy population, following the same convention as the 4-week inactivity threshold in L1-RTT-0001 (an audit-side interpretive choice, not a source-stated figure). Frailty is handled separately in Table 2/3 of the same source and is excluded here.

condition.check: positive exclusion flag in applicability.excludes; null/unknown flags do not reject

flagged.en: This ruleset is based on evidence for healthy older adults without frailty, uncontrolled hypertension, or unstable cardiovascular disease. If the target population falls outside this scope, these rules do not apply and the case should be routed to expert judgment (Layer 2) or excluded.
flagged.pt: Este conjunto de regras baseia-se em evidências para idosos saudáveis, sem fragilidade, hipertensão não controlada ou doença cardiovascular instável. Se a população-alvo estiver fora deste âmbito, estas regras não se aplicam e o caso deve ser encaminhado para avaliação especializada (Layer 2) ou excluído.
flagged.ja: 本ルールセットは「虚弱・未管理高血圧・不安定な心血管疾患のない健康な高齢者」を対象としたエビデンスに基づいています。対象者がこの範囲外の場合、このルールセットの適用外であり、専門家の判断(Layer2)または対象外として扱う必要があります。

pass.en: The target population (healthy older adult, no frailty, uncontrolled hypertension, or unstable cardiovascular disease) falls within the population this ruleset is designed for.

source.note: Overrides the general-adult minimum used in L1-RT-0003 (ACSM, min_sets=2) for this population: Table 1 explicitly recommends 1 set for beginners and older adults with frailty progressing to 2-3 sets.

condition.check: sets_per_exercise NOT BETWEEN min_sets AND max_sets

flagged.en: For healthy older adults, Table 1 recommends 1-3 sets per exercise per muscle group (1 set for beginners, progressing to 2-3). The current setting ({observed_value}) falls outside this range.
flagged.pt: Para idosos saudáveis, a Tabela 1 recomenda 1-3 séries por exercício por grupo muscular (1 série para iniciantes, progredindo para 2-3). A configuração atual ({observed_value}) está fora deste intervalo.
flagged.ja: 健康な高齢者の場合、Table1では1種目あたり1–3セット/筋群が推奨されています(初心者は1セットから2–3セットへ漸増)。現在の設定({observed_value})はこの範囲外です。

pass.en: Set volume ({observed_value} set(s)/exercise) falls within the range Table 1 recommends for healthy older adults (1-3 sets/exercise/muscle group).

condition.check: repetitions_per_set NOT BETWEEN min_reps AND max_reps

flagged.en: For healthy older adults, Table 1 recommends 8-12 or 10-15 repetitions (6-12 for strength; 10-15 at lower relative resistance for beginners). The current setting ({observed_value}) falls outside the overall 6-15 range these recommendations span.
flagged.pt: Para idosos saudáveis, a Tabela 1 recomenda 8-12 ou 10-15 repetições (6-12 para força; 10-15 com resistência relativa mais baixa para iniciantes). A configuração atual ({observed_value}) está fora do intervalo global de 6-15 abrangido por estas recomendações.
flagged.ja: 健康な高齢者の場合、Table1では8–12回または10–15回(筋力向上目的は6–12回、初心者は低負荷で10–15回)が推奨されています。現在の設定({observed_value})はこれらを包含する6–15回の範囲外です。

pass.en: Repetitions per set ({observed_value}) fall within the 6-15 range Table 1 recommends for healthy older adults.

source.note: Table 1 states loads should begin at a tolerated resistance and progress via periodization toward 70-85% 1RM; lighter loads are explicitly recommended for beginners, frailty, CVD, or osteoporosis. This rule therefore only flags established/progressed programs, not initial-phase or explicitly caveated cases.

condition.check: load_percent_1RM NOT BETWEEN min_intensity AND max_intensity

flagged.en: For strength goals in healthy older adults without frailty, CVD, or osteoporosis, Table 1 recommends progressing to 70-85% 1RM. The current setting ({observed_value}% 1RM) falls outside this range. Note that beginners and those with frailty, CVD, or osteoporosis should use lighter loads and progress more gradually.
flagged.pt: Para objetivos de força em idosos saudáveis, sem fragilidade, doença cardiovascular ou osteoporose, a Tabela 1 recomenda progredir para 70-85% de 1RM. A configuração atual ({observed_value}% de 1RM) está fora deste intervalo. Note que iniciantes e pessoas com fragilidade, doença cardiovascular ou osteoporose devem usar cargas mais leves e progredir mais gradualmente.
flagged.ja: 虚弱・心血管疾患・骨粗鬆症のない健康な高齢者の筋力向上目的の場合、Table1では70–85%1RMへの漸進が推奨されています。現在の設定({observed_value}%1RM)はこの範囲外です。ただし初心者、虚弱・心血管疾患・骨粗鬆症のある方はより低負荷から、より緩やかに漸進すべき点に注意してください。

pass.en: For a strength goal, the prescribed load ({observed_value}% 1RM) falls within the 70-85% 1RM range Table 1 recommends for healthy older adults.

source.note: Narrower than the general-adult power range in L1-RT-0006 (ACSM, 30-70% 1RM). This value (40-60%) is repeated consistently in the body text for older adults (e.g. p.2023), not just the table, so confidence in this figure is high.

condition.check: load_percent_1RM NOT BETWEEN min_power_load AND max_power_load

flagged.en: For power/explosive training in healthy older adults, Table 1 recommends moderate loads of 40-60% 1RM performed at high concentric velocity. The current setting ({observed_value}% 1RM) falls outside this range.
flagged.pt: Para treino de potência/explosivo em idosos saudáveis, a Tabela 1 recomenda cargas moderadas de 40-60% de 1RM executadas com alta velocidade concêntrica. A configuração atual ({observed_value}% de 1RM) está fora deste intervalo.
flagged.ja: 健康な高齢者のパワー/爆発的トレーニングの場合、Table1では40–60%1RMの中負荷を高い求心性速度で行うことが推奨されています。現在の設定({observed_value}%1RM)はこの範囲外です。

pass.en: For a power goal, the prescribed load ({observed_value}% 1RM) falls within the 40-60% 1RM range Table 1 recommends for healthy older adults.

source.note: Source explicitly flags hypoglycemia risk during resistance exercise for this population, which elevates this above a purely cosmetic/optimality concern.

flagged.ja: 入力情報から関節痛または可動域制限(関節炎等)が示されています。Table3では無痛域内でのトレーニング(可動域制限マシンの使用等)が推奨されていますが、プランにはその配慮の記載が見当たりません。

source.section: Table 3 (Poor vision, equilibrium/balance, low-back pain, dropping weights row), p.2037
source.note: Narrower/more justified than the general Table 1 modality preference (deferred as advisory-only): here the free-weight caution is tied to a specific named risk factor (fall/vision/balance/back-pain), not a blanket beginner/frailty preference.

condition.check: (poor_vision_or_balance_present == true OR fall_risk_present == true OR low_back_pain_present == true) AND equipment_modality == 'free_weight_only'

flagged.en: The input indicates poor vision, balance impairment, fall risk, or low-back pain. Table 3 recommends considering weight machines over free weights for this population, but the plan uses free weights exclusively.
flagged.pt: A entrada indica visão reduzida, comprometimento do equilíbrio, risco de queda ou dor lombar. A Tabela 3 recomenda considerando máquinas em vez de pesos livres, mas o plano utiliza exclusivamente pesos livres.
flagged.ja: 入力情報から視力低下・平衡障害・転倒リスク・腰痛のいずれかが示されています。Table3ではこの対象者にフリーウェイトよりマシンの使用検討が推奨されていますが、プランはフリーウェイトのみを使用しています。

source.note: Older-adult-specific rationale (joint stress reduction) is more explicit here than in the general-adult ACSM equivalent (L1-RT-0007).

flagged.en: Training every set to momentary muscular failure is not required to improve strength, hypertrophy, or power in older adults. Table 1 specifically recommends performing repetitions in an intensity zone that avoids failure to reduce joint stress. This should not be imposed as a mandatory requirement.
flagged.pt: Treinar todas as séries até à falha muscular momentânea não é necessário para melhorar a força, a hipertrofia ou a potência em idosos. A Tabela 1 recomenda especificamente realizar as repetições numa zona de intensidade que evite a falha, para reduzir o stress articular. Isto não deve ser imposto como requisito obrigatório.
flagged.ja: 毎セットを完全な筋力低下(failure)まで追い込むことは、高齢者の筋力・筋肥大・パワーの向上に必須ではありません。Table1では特に、関節へのストレスを軽減するためfailureを避ける強度域での反復が推奨されています。必須要件として課すべきではありません。

pass.en: The plan does not mandate training every set to momentary muscular failure, consistent with Table 1's recommendation to avoid failure to reduce joint stress in older adults.

source.section: Summary Statement 1; body text 'A Properly Designed Resistance Training Program...Is Safe for Healthy Older Adults', p.2021
source.note: Cites a systematic review of physically frail oldest-old (70-92yo) reporting only one case of shoulder pain across 20 studies and 2,544 subjects.

flagged.en: Both research and clinical experience indicate resistance training is safe for healthy older adults when properly designed with appropriate instruction and spotting. A systematic review of physically frail oldest-old adults (70-92 years) found only one case of shoulder pain across 20 studies and 2,544 subjects. Absent a specific identified contraindication, unfounded claims of excessive danger are inaccurate.
flagged.pt: Tanto a investigação como a experiência clínica indicam que o treino de resistência é seguro para idosos saudáveis quando corretamente concebido, com instrução e supervisão adequadas. Uma revisão sistemática de idosos fisicamente frágeis (70-92 anos) encontrou apenas um caso de dor no ombro em 20 estudos e 2.544 participantes. Na ausência de uma contraindicação específica identificada, afirmações infundadas de perigo excessivo são incorretas.
flagged.ja: 研究・臨床経験のいずれも、適切な指導とスポッティングを伴う適切に設計されたレジスタンストレーニングは健康な高齢者にとって安全であることを示しています。70〜92歳の身体的に虚弱な最高齢層を対象とした系統的レビューでは、20研究・2,544人中、肩の痛みが1例報告されたのみでした。具体的な禁忌事項が特定されていない場合、根拠のない過度な危険性の主張は不正確です。

pass.en: The plan does not make unfounded claims that resistance training is unsafe for this healthy older adult population absent a specific identified contraindication.

source.section: 'General formats for progression' (Conlon et al. comparison study), p.2026
source.note: Stronger evidence than the general-adult ACSM equivalent (L1-RT-0009): the source explicitly contrasts older adults with younger populations, where periodized programs DO show superiority. For older adults specifically, no such superiority was found.

flagged.en: A landmark direct comparison (Conlon et al.) found no differences in strength, functional capacity, or other outcomes between periodized and non-periodized resistance training in older adults after 22 weeks -- unlike younger populations, where periodized programs do show superiority. A complex periodization structure should not be treated as a mandatory requirement for older adults.
flagged.pt: Um estudo de referência com comparação direta (Conlon et al.) não encontrou diferenças na força, capacidade funcional ou outros resultados entre treino de resistência periodizado e não periodizado em idosos após 22 semanas -- ao contrário de populações mais jovens, onde os programas periodizados demonstram superioridade. Uma estrutura de periodização complexa não deve ser tratada como requisito obrigatório para idosos.
flagged.ja: Conlon et al.による直接比較研究では、22週間後の高齢者において、periodized(期分け)とnon-periodizedのレジスタンストレーニングの間で、筋力・機能的能力等に差が見られませんでした。これは、periodizedプログラムが優位性を示す若年層とは対照的です。複雑な期分け構造を高齢者に対する必須要件として課すべきではありません。

pass.en: The plan does not impose a complex periodization structure as a strict requirement, consistent with evidence that periodization is not shown to be superior to non-periodized programs in older adults.

flagged.en: Countering muscle disuse through resistance training is a powerful intervention to combat the loss of muscle strength and mass, physiological vulnerability, and their debilitating consequences on physical functioning, mobility, independence, and healthy life expectancy in older adults. If there is a muscle function goal, engaging in some form of resistance training is recommended over none.
flagged.pt: Contrariar o desuso muscular através do treino de resistência é uma intervenção poderosa para combater a perda de força e massa muscular, a vulnerabilidade fisiológica, e as suas consequências debilitantes na funcionalidade física, mobilidade, independência e esperança de vida saudável em idosos. Se existir um objetivo de função muscular, recomenda-se a realização de alguma forma de treino de resistência em vez de nenhuma.
flagged.ja: 筋の廃用に対抗するレジスタンストレーニングは、高齢者における筋力・筋量の低下、生理学的脆弱性、そしてそれらが身体機能・可動性・自立・健康寿命に及ぼす深刻な影響に対抗する強力な介入です。筋機能に関する目標がある場合、何もしないよりも何らかの形のレジスタンストレーニングの実施が推奨されます。

pass.en: The plan recommends engaging in some form of resistance training, consistent with evidence that any resistance training outperforms none for muscle strength, mass, and functional outcomes in older adults.

ruleset_notes.verification_status_meaning: pending_source_check = extracted by LLM, not yet manually cross-checked against the source PDF. verified = manually confirmed against source.
ruleset_notes.population_classification_design: target_population is a mutually exclusive classification, not a set of co-occurring tags. When age routes a case to older_adult_healthy (provisional threshold: age >= 65), healthy_adult_18plus (ACSM ruleset) must NOT also be set for the same case, to prevent both rulesets firing simultaneously with conflicting numeric thresholds (e.g. L1-RT-0003 vs L1-RT-NSCA-0002).
ruleset_notes.deferred_items: Nonconsecutive-day frequency check deferred: plan_extractor has no field distinguishing consecutive vs nonconsecutive training days, so this would always resolve to null/unevaluable. Revisit if such a field is added. Exercise-count (8-10) and modality (machine vs free-weight) rules also deferred as advisory/descriptive rather than prescriptive thresholds.
ruleset_notes.extraction_confidence_asymmetry: Table 3 accommodation fields (whether a plan indicates a specific safety/modification measure, e.g. blood_glucose_monitoring_mentioned, rom_restricted_training_mentioned) require semantic judgment from plan_extractor, unlike Table 1's numeric fields which are near-mechanical extraction. Because a false positive here (incorrectly marking an accommodation as present) causes the rule to incorrectly return pass -- a more dangerous failure mode than a false negative (which resolves to insufficient_data for human review) -- these fields use a stricter null-if-uncertain policy: mark true only on clear, explicit textual evidence; ambiguous or suggestive language resolves to null, not true or false.
ruleset_notes.population_exclusivity_gap_fix: L1-RT-NSCA-0012 through 0015 were added after discovering that the population-exclusivity design (L1-RT-0001 gate logic) silently drops ACSM's general-adult caution rules L1-RT-0007 through 0010 for any plan routed to older_adult_healthy, since those ACSM rules only declare population: healthy_adult_18plus. These 4 new rules restore equivalent coverage for older adults, each backed by older-adult-specific evidence from the NSCA source rather than a blind copy of the ACSM rule.
